description: Tool registry. An agent can use a tool only if the tool is granted to it in org.json AND the tool declares the action. Connector 'internal' runs locally; 'dry_run' records exactly what would be sent and never contacts the outside world; 'live' requires a reviewed adapter (none are registered in the MVP).

tools.name: Docs Workspace
tools.description: Create and revise internal draft documents, briefings, and reports.

tools.name: Approved Sources Reader
tools.description: Read operator-provided and allow-listed public sources. Every finding keeps its source reference.

tools.name: Analytics Engine
tools.description: Deterministic scoring and analysis over internal data. Rubrics are shown in every output.

tools.name: Code Workspace
tools.description: Draft patches and reviews. Commits go to non-default branches only.

tools.name: CI Sandbox
tools.description: Run test suites in an isolated sandbox.

tools.name: Deployment Pipeline
tools.description: Deployment plans and gated deploys. Deploys are dry-run receipts until a reviewed adapter is registered.

tools.name: Security Config Auditor
tools.description: Audit the office's own agent grants, tool registry, and policy; draft incident reports.

tools.name: Security Administration
tools.description: Security configuration changes and scoped credential handles. Never returns secret values to agents.

tools.name: Content Studio
tools.description: Draft posts and articles against brand guidelines; maintain the internal content calendar.

tools.name: Social Publisher
tools.description: Publish approved posts. Dry-run receipt until a reviewed adapter is registered.

tools.name: CRM Pipeline
tools.description: Internal pipeline records and outreach drafts. Drafts are never sent by this tool.

tools.name: Email Outbox
tools.description: Send approved emails. Dry-run receipt until a reviewed adapter is registered.

tools.name: Finance Desk
tools.description: Purchases, payments, and live price changes. Every action requires operator approval.

tools.name: Contracts Desk
tools.description: Legal commitments. Critical tier; operator approval with change and rollback plans.

tools.name: Data Warehouse
tools.description: Data export and deletion. Both are gated; deletion is critical.

tools.name: Memory Vault
tools.description: Short-term task memory and proposals to long-term company memory. Promotion needs operator approval.

tools.name: Simulation Sandbox
tools.description: Seeded what-if models over operator-stated assumptions. No access to production systems or external parties.
